name: transportadora-financeiro
description: Módulo financeiro de transportadora com frota terceirizada

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait db && npm run db:setup -w apps/api && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose up -d --wait db && npm run db:reset -w apps/api
